history.description: The song_model.dart file defines the SongModel class, which encapsulates the properties and behaviors of a music track, including attributes such as id, title, artist, album, data path, duration, and whether the track is an asset. This class provides methods to format the duration of the song, clean the title by removing unnecessary characters, and return a default artist name if the artist is unknown or empty.

history.description: The audio_service.dart file defines the AudioService class, which is responsible for managing audio playback in the application. It handles functionalities such as song queueing, playback controls, and session management for audio interruptions, ensuring a seamless audio experience for users.

history.author: Atharv Mannur
history.description: The song_list_tile.dart file defines a stateless widget called SongListTile, which is used to display a tile representing a song in a music application. It shows the song's title, artist, duration, and playback status, providing a visual interface for users to interact with the song playback functionality.

history.author: Atharv Mannur
history.description: The atharv_music_screen.dart file defines the AtharvMusicScreen, a Flutter screen that presents a user interface for displaying a list of music tracks. It allows users to search and view songs that are bundled within the application. The screen manages the loading of song assets, handles user input for searching, and updates the UI accordingly based on the state of the song data.

history.author: Atharv Mannur
history.description: The music_scanner.dart file defines the MusicScanner class, which is responsible for scanning the device's storage for audio files while managing the necessary permissions for accessing media. It provides methods to check, request, and verify permissions, as well as to recursively scan directories for audio files, returning a list of found songs represented by the SongModel class.

history.author: Atharv Mannur
history.description: The mini_player.dart file defines a MiniPlayer widget that provides a compact interface for music playback, allowing users to view current song details and control playback actions such as play, pause, skip, and navigate to a full player screen.

history.description: The home_screen.dart file defines the HomeScreen widget, which serves as the main interface for navigating between different screens in the application, including music, mixer, and library functionalities. It utilizes a bottom navigation bar to switch between these screens and manages the state of the currently selected screen.
